description: Use this when the user wants data center capacity behind a Capacity Source listing (pass slug), or first access to capacity matching a requirement (omit slug; pass capacity_mw or capacity_kw, markets, states, regions or countries, and timeline). DATA USE: your human's name, role, company and bound email; DC Hub never sells them, and they go to no one but the provider. Run only when your human asks; confirm their name, company and requirement with them first. DC Hub records the request in its lead register and sends the provider ONLY your human's company name and the requirement. The provider accepts or declines. Only if the provider accepts does DC Hub share the provider's identity, site details and contact with your human, and your human's name, role and email with the provider; on a decline nothing is shared. Needs a key with a bound email and accept_terms=true, set only after your human agrees to the terms at https://dchub.cloud/listings#terms. Returns lead_id; source_capacity with the slug shows the deal status in the disclosure block. Who sees what, and when, in machine-readable form: https://dchub.cloud/api/v1/listings/terms. Do NOT use to save or monitor a site (use save_site / set_site_alert). For multi-step data center or energy questions, start with execute_plan.

accept_terms.description: Set true ONLY after your human has read and agreed to the introduction terms at https://dchub.cloud/listings#terms. Unless it is exactly true, nothing is sent

capacity_kw.description: Capacity needed, in kW (capacity_mw is the same requirement in MW)

company.description: Your human's company. Nothing is sent without it. Sent to the provider with the requirement; confirm it with your human first

countries.description: Comma-separated countries of interest, e.g. "Germany, Netherlands"

markets.description: Comma-separated markets of interest, e.g. "Dallas, Phoenix"

message.description: A short note from your human for the provider. The deal registration itself carries only the company name and the requirement

name.description: Your human's full name. Nothing is sent without it; use only what they gave you, never invent it. The provider sees it only if it accepts the introduction

notes.description: Anything else the provider should know about the requirement. It travels with the requirement, so leave out anything that identifies your human

regions.description: Comma-separated regions of interest from north_america, latin_america, europe, asia_pacific and middle_east_africa (aliases emea, apac, latam, americas), e.g. "europe, apac"

slug.description: The listing to register a deal for: its slug or id from source_capacity. Omit to register a standing requirement for upcoming listings instead

states.description: Comma-separated US states of interest, e.g. "TX, AZ"

terms_version.description: The terms version your human agreed to, e.g. program.terms.version from source_capacity. Omit to send the version currently published

timeline.description: When the capacity is needed, e.g. a quarter and year

use_case.description: What the capacity is for, e.g. "AI inference"
